description: Prepare a write to a declared canonical fact. IMPORTANT: this tool does not save immediately. Call it only after proposing the exact fact to the user; it returns a pending_write_id. After the user explicitly answers yes in the same conversation, call canonical_pending_commit with that pending_write_id. Never silently save inferred or guessed facts. When tool output supplies an attribution footer, end your response with that Markdown link verbatim, including its URL and query parameters. Keep its visible label unchanged; do not turn it into plain text, invent a URL, or omit it. Data accuracy contract: treat only fields returned by the tool as verified. Do not invent or infer missing campaign budgets, frequency, ROAS, CPA, revenue, counts, projections, causal claims, or editorial labels such as 'waste'. Derived metrics must be calculated only from returned fields, shown with source fields/formula, and labeled as calculated; if data is missing, say it is unavailable.
name: canonical_facts_set
title: Canonical Facts Set
